text:
Maria G: Hey team — PR #21089 is green locally and ready to land but CI queue is ~12m and we want to avoid the 22:00 deploy freeze. Can someone give quick eyes or advise if we should wait for the rebase window? Link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/21089> :eyes:
Lee T: Looking now. Which tests have been flaky? I can review but I won't be able to merge during the freeze window.
Maria G: Main flake was `integration/streaming` (intermittent). I pushed a small retry patch to the branch; previous CI run showed `mac-e2e` failing. It's queued again.
CI Bot: CI status for PR #21089 — queued (position 7). Last run: mac-e2e failed (flake). Suggested action: request a re-run after approvals. See CI details: <https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/87421>
Josh P: I can take the review in ~30m. If CI won't clear before freeze, let's target the 04:00 rebase window. I can also do a quick approve now if Maria wants me to trigger reruns.
Samira R: If CI stays stuck, we could consider a manual canary to Dedicated, but that's higher risk. @DevOps Oncall any wiggle room on tonight's freeze or a safe hotfix path?
DevOps Oncall: Freeze is firm 22:00-02:00 UTC for infra maintenance. We allow emergency hotfixes with a documented rollback plan only. If not urgent, hold for the 04:00 rebase window. If you escalate, ping me with the PR link and I'll pre-approve a rollback runbook.
Maria G: Thanks. Josh — please sanity-check quickly and approve if it's non-blocking; otherwise we'll hold for 04:00. I'll draft a rollback snippet and tag oncall if we go hotfix.
Josh P: Quick pass done. Small nit in `response_router` (logging var), non-blocking. Approving now. :+1: Merge when CI is green and it's outside the freeze.
Maria G: Approved — thanks. CI Bot, please rerun on approval.
CI Bot: Rerun triggered by approval. New status: running (est. 9m). Build id: 87421.
Maria G: If this finishes before 22:00 we'll merge; otherwise hold for 04:00 rebase window. I will update this thread once CI is final.
DevOps Oncall: Noted. If you decide to merge pre-freeze, post the rollback command and tag @DevOps Oncall in #releases.
Maria G: Will do. Thanks everyone :pray:
